personal_info.positioning: I design and build large-scale systems end to end — from enterprise strategy and architecture to production code and delivery.
personal_info.summary: Enterprise and solution architect with a hands-on engineering background in banking, payments, telecom and the public sector. Takes initiatives from idea to production: concept and target architecture, technology and vendor choices, team setup, and architecture oversight through delivery. Built and led backend and card-processing engineering teams that delivered parts of a leading digital bank app (3M+ users), and defined architecture for a state-owned enterprise's digital transformation across 50+ systems and 10+ vendors. Currently provides regional technical advisory and solution architecture for banks across CEMEA.

summary_linkedin.text:
I design and build large-scale systems end to end, from enterprise strategy and architecture to production code and delivery.

My background is engineering. I started in telecom and card processing, grew into leading backend and card-processing teams at Azerbaijan's largest private bank, and moved into architecture: the digital transformation programs of Azerbaijan's national railway, and today regional technical advisory for banks across CEMEA at Visa.

What I do best:
• Take an initiative from an idea to production: concept, target architecture, technology and vendor choices, team setup, delivery oversight
• Design distributed, event-driven and integration-heavy systems for banking and payments
• Align business strategy with technology: roadmaps, architecture principles, governance
• Build and lead engineering teams that ship

I choose languages and tools by what fits the problem, not by habit.

Domains: banking, payments and card processing, telecom, public sector.
Certifications: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, PMP, ITIL Foundation.

offers.name: Architecture Advisory
offers.summary: Know your risks and your target architecture before a large investment.
offers.fit: A fit if you are preparing a major build, a vendor decision or a modernization, or if outages and slow releases have become a business problem, and you do not need a full-time enterprise architect.
includes: Architecture review with risks ranked by business impact
Target architecture and a roadmap your team can execute

offers.name: Fractional Technical Leadership
offers.summary: Senior technical judgment without a full-time executive hire.
offers.fit: A fit if technical decisions are piling up on a founder or CEO, if you depend on vendors you cannot fully assess, or if you are building your first engineering team.
includes: Delivery oversight: quality, risk and timelines

offers.name: End-to-End Development
offers.summary: From an idea to production and handover, built by the person who designed it.
offers.fit: A fit if you have a clear business need and want one accountable person rather than a vendor team.
includes: Deployment into production with monitoring and a rollback plan
Documentation and handover, so your team owns the result

Large delivery teams. If you need fifteen people, you need a different kind of partner.
